adjudication_note: Two normative operators, which is the layer the original request calls `os termos essenciais`. `sem prejuízo de` occurs 26 times and is not an absence marker at all — it is the clause that PRESERVES what follows (`sem prejuízo das penalidades cabíveis` = the penalties still apply), so polarity.absence firing on its `sem` was a sense error, and the campaign's answer was to forbid the collocation. Forbidding was the only tool available while the matcher was leftmost-then-longest; with global longest-match the compound pre-empts the fragment on its own, so registering the operator both captures it and retires the prohibition. Same for `à medida que`, which is proportionality, not measurement. The English label of the proportionality operator is `in proportion as` and not `as`: a preferred label becomes an automatic surface, and `as` is the Portuguese feminine plural article — the dry run fired it on `À medida que AS taxas de juros mudam`, which is thousands of occurrences of pure noise. A label in one language must not be a surface the other language spends on something else.

concepts.def: Marks that what follows remains fully in force despite the provision just stated.
Marks that the governed effect varies in step with the stated change.
